what: Behind the person and text, a thick round-ended curve with an accent → pale accent gradient is drawn like a pen stroke over 1.2s (power3.inOut), stays for 5.9s, then keeps going in the same direction and exits over 1.2s. With several shapes, the next curve continues the drawing, with just one it draws once and stays (sub-section header — 1.3s)

options.hold: Time until it starts fading after being drawn (s, including drawing time), default 5.9
options.loop: When off, even with several, only the first shape is drawn and then it stops
options.--fx-from · --fx-to: Gradient start and end colors (css), default --kf-accent → --kf-accent-soft
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: One curve set (svg) — one path and two stops inside ([data-fx-part=from]·[data-fx-part=to])

use: …
note: On exit the dashoffset goes from 2L to L so the tail of the line follows forward and disappears — it does not rewind

from.where: shared.js ChCurve — index.html hero (three shapes every 5.9s) · list.html sub header (1.3s once)
